pattern: authenticated context without a discovered thread id
experience: An Orbit work session could list planning data but could not identify itself safely when its shell thread id was unset. Shared install credentials and supplied thread IDs are not caller authentication.

setup.context: Orbit is configured for this session. The Orbit skill has already been read. T3CODE_THREAD_ID is unset; no shell discovery is necessary. Use the authenticated T3 Orbit tool.

prompt: Read my own Orbit ticket through authenticated MCP, then add the note "Authenticated session checks passed" to the ticket returned. Do not supply a caller identity, use shell/HTTP, or read credentials.
